notes: This is the 230V/16A "Contractor Series" SmartSequencer (also written CN-3600SE / CN-3600S-E); Furman's current catalog has no separate 120V "CN-3600S" SKU at this 3600W tier (the 120V siblings are CN-1800S at 15A and CN-2400S at 20A), so this is treated as the product the user means. AC inlet is an IEC C19 female inlet with a captive IEC C19-to-Schuko (CEE 7/7) cord for the 230V export market; represented here as IEC-C19 connector type since that is the physical receptacle on the chassis (cord plug end varies by destination country and is not itself a chassis port). The three terminal-block ports (SmartSequencing Link, Remote, Force Off/Delay 3) are Phoenix-style pluggable screw terminals (4-pin, 4-pin, and 5-pin respectively); mapped to the closest listed connector id "euroblock" since no dedicated Phoenix-terminal id exists. RS-232 is a DB-9 connector used for control/integration (bidirectional per Furman's command-set documentation) and also serves as the uplink for the optional BB-RS232-to-Ethernet BlueBOLT adapter (that adapter is a separate accessory, not a built-in port, so no Ethernet/RJ45 port is listed). No bandwidth "grade" applies to any port here (IEC, RS-232, and euroblock control ports are not on the graded connector scales). Rack size confirmed as 1U from Furman marketing copy; exact width/depth/weight figures were not found on the primary spec page and are omitted rather than guessed.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC C19 female inlet; captive cord to Schuko (CEE 7/7) for 230V export markets

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: DB-9; system integration and control-system command set; also uplink for optional BB-RS232 BlueBOLT Ethernet adapter

ports.name: SmartSequencing Link
ports.note: 4-pin pluggable screw terminal; primary/secondary bidirectional current-loop link between chained units, ~1000 ft nominal

ports.name: Remote
ports.note: 4-pin pluggable screw terminal; +12V, STAT, REM, GND remote on/off and status, Class 2 wiring

ports.name: Force Off / Delay 3
ports.note: 5-pin pluggable screw terminal for force-off contact closure and delay-bank-3 control
